zh: 按钮边框、触控尺寸、表单间距和长文字换行统一调整
底部滚动空间随导航和固定操作栏实际高度调整，最后一行色块不再遮挡
OpenAI语音转写与翻译接口、保留原声、先文字后翻译、失败重试和预算保护
减少聊天重复渲染，限制同时处理任务，修复异步结果和账号切换隔离
en: Clear action buttons, touch targets, form spacing and wrapped labels
Measured bottom navigation clearance keeps the last work tiles visible
OpenAI speech and translation integration, transcript-first UI, retry and budget protection
Less chat repainting, bounded processing and account-safe asynchronous results
